title: Provable Hallucination Bounds in Retrieval-Augmented Scientific Generation
summary: Hallucinations in scientific literature retrieval threaten the integrity of autonomous discovery. We prove formal Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) statistical bounds on hallucination occurrence under cross-encoder Natural Language Inference (NLI) filtering. On a benchmark of 5,000 generated scientific propositions, setting the entailment threshold to tau=0.85 bounds residual hallucination risk below 3.8% with 95% confidence.
